product.name: Quantix pH 2000
product.description: The Quantix pH 2000 offers precise, real‑time pH measurement for research laboratories, teaching facilities, and industrial quality control. Featuring a high‑resolution liquid crystal display and a calibrated sensor probe, the device delivers ±0.01 pH accuracy across a range of 0–14. The compact design measures 12 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm and weighs 0.9 kg, making it easy to integrate into bench setups. It supports USB‑to‑PC connectivity and optional Bluetooth for wireless data logging, and includes a rechargeable lithium‑ion battery for portable use. The instrument is built with a stainless‑steel housing and polycarbonate housing, ensuring durability and chemical resistance. The pH 2000 is ideal for routine titrations, buffer preparation, and environmental sampling. Its user-friendly interface and quick calibration routine make it a reliable choice for both experienced researchers and students.
